title: Restore a Motif store
description: Puts a Motif backup back beside the project after checking every file against its receipt. It refuses while the store is open or busy, when the backup is of a newer schema or a different project (unless --force is given), and when a file does not match its sha256. It never deletes: the old store, its -wal and -shm, and any owned file the backup lacks move into a pre-restore folder before the restored files are renamed in.
